events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 아스널 narrow the gap on leaders 에버턴 who are held 1–1 by 셰필드 웬즈데이 and have top scorer Adrian Heath carried off with a serious knee injury. In the Second Division, 포츠머스 and 블랙번 로버스 draw a top of the table clash 2–2 at Fratton Park with the home side fighting back after gifting the visitors two own goals.
선덜랜드 surprise 토트넘 홋스퍼 in the Milk Cup with a 2–1 replay win at White Hart Lane. Goalkeeper Chris Turner saves a Graham Roberts penalty. 퀸스 파크 레인저스 finally put out 사우샘프턴 4–0 in their second replay.

토트넘 홋스퍼 move to within a point of 에버턴 after coming from behind to beat 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 3–1. The leaders are held 0–0 at 퀸스 파크 레인저스 where Pat Van Den Hauwe and Simon Stainrod are sent off. 맨체스터 유나이티드 lose at 노팅엄 포리스트 and 사우샘프턴 beat 아스널 – only three points now separate the top five. Telford United record the most eye-catching result in the FA Cup second round, a 4–1 win at 프레스턴 노스 엔드. Other non-league clubs through to round three are 버턴 앨비언 , winners at 올더숏 , and Dagenham, who knock out 피터버러 유나이티드 .
인데펜디엔테 of Argentina beat 리버풀 1–0 to win the World Club Championship in FC 도쿄 .
Argentina's 인데펜디엔테 wins the Intercontinental Cup in FC 도쿄, Japan by defeating England 's 리버풀 F.C. : 1–0. The only goal is scored by José Alberto Percudani in the 6th minute.
맨체스터 유나이티드 win 3–2 at 던디 유나이티드 (5–4 aggregate) and 토트넘 홋스퍼 draw 1–1 with Bohemians Prague (3–1 aggregate) to ensure safe passage through to the UEFA Cup quarter-finals.

에버턴 maintain their place at the top of the First Division with a 5–0 win over 노팅엄 포리스트 for whom Chris Fairclough is sent off and Gary Mills breaks a leg. 사우샘프턴 lose 2–1 at 코번트리 시티, their first league defeat since 4 September.
리버풀's revival continues with a 2–0 win at 퀸스 파크 레인저스 that moves them up to fifth in the table.

토트넘 홋스퍼 win 2–1 at 노리치 시티 to reclaim leadership of the First Division as 에버턴 are beaten 4–3 at home by 첼시, for whom recent signing Gordon Davies scores a hat-trick. Two goals in the last two minutes by transfer-listed Alan Biley give 포츠머스 a 2–1 win over 옥스퍼드 유나이티드.

Bottom of the First Division with only one win and eight points all season, 스토크 시티 stun 맨체스터 유나이티드 2–1 at the Victoria Ground . 리버풀 suffer a surprise home defeat to 레스터 시티 but 에버턴 win at 선덜랜드. 토트넘 홋스퍼 stay top on goal difference despite being held at home by 웨스트햄 유나이티드.

The year ends with 토트넘 홋스퍼 heading the First Division after beating 선덜랜드 2–0. 에버턴 win by the same score at 입스위치 타운 to stay on their heels. 블랙번 로버스 top Division Two although a 3–1 home defeat to 허더즈필드 타운 cuts their lead to three points while 브래드퍼드 시티 and Bury are both clear at the top of the Third and Fourth Divisions respectively.
